exception.reason: Same closure-namespace libart.so NOLOAD guard as approved N11b 48dac28f / N11d a47060a64bc0 / N11e 494433395ad8 (n11f-child.c:339, line shifted). N11f REMOVES the N11b dlns_inherit+owner-NOLOAD verify block (now returns the resident sealed handle) and makes the HiLog marker non-fatal; it adds no new NOLOAD. The guard is dominated by the provider dlopen_ns at n11f-child.c:328 whose DT_NEEDED maps route-a libart into the same namespace -- invisible to the N1 call scanner, which is why it reports 'no dominating guarded same-namespace load'. Runtime proof: N11e 61b branch-3 showed ART lookup passed before owner mismatch. Outer-reviewed 2026-10-02.
exception.removal_condition: N11f 61b short observation window only; re-review before any N11 build enters a unified state.
